en: Black‑and‑white street scene in a European town, showing a cobblestoned main street lined with 3‑story buildings and shopfronts. On the right are signs for various businesses with window displays and hanging plants; on the left a road sign points toward nearby towns. In the center background rises a large church with a tall onion‑domed tower and cross finial behind bare trees. Numerous people, including children, walk or stand in traditional early‑20th‑century clothing, suggesting an everyday market‑day atmosphere.
